cases.description: An unregistered template name is an explicit, actionable CLI error (exit code 1, listing the known template names) rather than a silent no-op or a crash — matching this project's standing discipline of failing loudly and specifically on invalid input rather than guessing.
cases.grounding: engine/cli.py: get_template(args.template) is None triggers 'error: unknown template ... (known: ...)' on stderr and returns 1.
